issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

csrfProtection.description: Flag to enable csrf token generation and checking

originFilter.description:
Flag to enable origin checks and disallow origins that
are not present in the allowedOrigins field

originFilterHostnameMatch.description: If set to true, the Origin/Referer Header check is performed using a hostname match instead of a complete string match.

allowedOrigins.description:
The allowedOrigins are checked against the 'Origin' request header.
Or in it's absence, the 'Referer' request header.
Note that the entries must be valid and parseable URLs, if originFilterHostnameMatch is set to true.

allowedHeaders.description:
The allowedHeaders are provided in response to the 'Access-Control-Request-Headers' preflight request header.
Note that entries must be valid HTTP header names.
